name: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc.
blurb: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is a major integrated steel producer operating in the United States and Canada, founded in 1847 and employing approximately 25,000 people. The company manufactures a broad range of flat-rolled steel products — including hot-rolled, cold-rolled, coated sheet, stainless, electrical, and plate products — serving primarily automotive and industrial customers. It also produces upstream raw materials such as iron ore, HBI, coal, and coke, and downstream non-steelmaking goods including stamped components, tubing, and tool-and-die products.
recent: In October 2025, Cleveland-Cliffs executed what analysts described as a 'transformative deal' tied to Trump-era steel tariffs, triggering a sharp stock surge. As of mid-May 2026, shares trade near $10.99 — within a 52-week range of $5.63 to $16.70 — reflecting elevated volatility (beta 2.01) and a trailing net loss of approximately $1.22 billion on $18.9 billion in revenue. The company reported its most recent quarterly results on April 20, 2026; analyst consensus is Hold with a price target of $10.43.
